name: Mira Singh
household: Joint family: parents, brother, sister-in-law, and nephew
psychographics: Manages a strict household budget; believes in buying quality that lasts to reduce long-term replacement costs.
current_solutions: Uses the Paytm Malls app for weekly groceries, buys staples in bulk from local 'ration shops', and repurposes old clothing for household use.
frustration: The local ration shop raised the price of wheat flour by 5 rupees per kg at 10:45 AM yesterday, breaking her monthly budget sheet; she had to switch to a more expensive brand at the supermarket.
decision_style: Calculates cost-per-use meticulously; will spend more upfront if the item lasts twice as long, otherwise defaults to the cheapest option.
voice: Slightly formal with sprinkled Hindi/Urdu phrases; speaks in a measured, rhythmic pace when discussing money.
